note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 redescription of Eutermes dendrophilus (Desn.) (in German, with the worker quoted directly from Desneux's French original); the species was named by Desneux in 1906 (as Termes Ripperti subsp. dendrophilus). Type localities Ecuador, Guayaquil etc. The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to E. chaquimayensis but larger (alate with wings 16—17.5 mm, head length 1.78 mm, head width 1.53 mm); compound eyes larger and more prominent, the base of the postclypeus — especially laterally — strongly bristled, antennae longer with the outer segments oval and strongly contracted at the base; soldier head pale brown with a dark nasus, the nasus on the same plane as the vertex, antennae 13-segmented.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very close to E. chaquimayensis but larger; compound eyes larger and more prominent; base of the postclypeus strongly bristled, especially on the sides; antennae longer, the outer segments oval and strongly contracted at the base, so that the antennae look very fragile. Several short branches run from the media towards the radius sector. Measurements: body length (with wings) 16—17.5 mm; head length 1.78 mm; head width 1.53 mm; from the anterior margin of the transverse band to the occiput 1.05 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale brown, nasus dark, paler around the antennal bases; hardened parts of the body yellowish brown (rusty brown), legs rusty yellow. Bristles as in E. brevioculatus, but the bristles on the anterior margin of the pronotum are longer and the abdominal tergites are also hairy. Head shape as in E. brevioculatus, but the nasus lies on the same plane as the vertex. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 3 twice segment 2 or only slightly shorter, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 5 longer still. Anterior lobe of the pronotum (almost) perpendicular to the posterior lobe, anterior margin hardly concave. Measurements: body length 4.5 mm (n=2); head width about 0.95—1.06 mm (the original figures are partly damaged in the OCR; head length not cited).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Holmgren quotes Desneux's French description directly: head large, tinged chestnut-brown (of varying depth), the head capsule sutures pale and clear; postclypeus not very prominent; antennae 14-segmented, segment 5 usually distinctly more... (the original is cut off here); pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe upturned, its anterior margin very weakly concave in the middle; abdomen swollen, the tergites yellowish brown (of varying depth). (The quotation gives no numerical measurements in the original.)
